NBA DFS Picks for Monday, November 23 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, November 23 · 8 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 23, 4:31 PM ET

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is the top-projected player on the Monday, November 23 DraftKings main slate at 48.3 DraftKings points for $10,200. Alperen Sengun (HOU, 47.6, $9,500) and Scottie Barnes (TOR, 47.0, $8,900) are next.

Jalen Slawson (IND) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 7.32 projected points per $1,000 at $3,400.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 23, 4:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
